'''Jom''' was a resident of [[V'saine]] who lived during the [[Age of Legends]].  

==History==

He accidentally knocks down [[Charn]] when both are not watching where they are going just before the hole is bored into the Dark One's prison and the [[Collam Daan]] is destroyed.{{ref/book|4|26}}
